c.title: $5,500 / 3br - 1250ft2 - Luxury 3 Bed + Den | 3 Bath | 2 Parking | 8X On The Park | Yaletown (Vancouver West)
c.description:
Experience luxury sub-penthouse downtown living at 8X On The Park, one of Vancouver's premier residences, overlooking beautiful Emery Barnes Park in the heart of Yaletown!

Address:330X-1111 Richard Street
This stunning 3-bedroom + den, 3-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,250 sq. ft. of elegant living space, complemented by a spacious private balcony and breathtaking panoramic views of Vancouver's city skyline and North Shore mountains.

Designed for comfortable family living and entertaining, this home features sophisticated finishes, a gourmet kitchen equipped with premium Miele appliances, spa-inspired bathrooms, and air conditioning throughout.

Enjoy an exceptional lifestyle with everything you need just steps away, including parks, restaurants, cafes, grocery stores, shopping, and convenient public transit.

PROPERTY FEATURES:
- Approximately 1,250 sq. ft. of interior living space
- 3 Bedrooms + Den
- 3 Full Bathrooms
- Spacious private balcony with stunning city and mountain views
- Air conditioning and central heating
- Gourmet kitchen with premium Miele appliances
- Miele gas cooktop, refrigerator, oven, range hood and dishwasher
- Microwave
- In-suite washer and dryer
- Walk-in closet with built-in organizers
- TWO secure underground parking stalls
- Private storage locker
UTILITIES INCLUDED:
- Gas
- Water
- Heating
- Air conditioning
Hydro and internet are not included. Furniture is not included.

LUXURY BUILDING AMENITIES:
- 24/7 concierge service
- Beautiful rooftop terrace with fireplaces and BBQ facilities
- Fully equipped fitness centre
- Dedicated yoga room
- Meeting room and entertainment space
- Secure bicycle storage with express bike elevator and repair facilities
UNBEATABLE YALETOWN LOCATION

Located right beside Emery Barnes Park, enjoy the convenience of downtown living with green space right outside your door.

Walking distance to:
- Yaletown restaurants, cafes and boutique shops
- Nesters Market and Shoppers Drug Mart
- Emery Barnes
